name: DownloadObjectStart
trigger: send the initial ordinary pull

name: HandleDownloadBegin
trigger: admit a pull while holding the table and operation locks

name: HandleDownloadMissing
trigger: after ref retirement, return retained finished status or missing-ref error; includes a late first acquisition

name: HandleDownloadMarkActive
trigger: update the sliding global inactivity clock

name: RefMarkReceiverActive
trigger: capture request time and publish ref activity under progress lock

name: TransactionMarkReceiverActive
trigger: publish the same captured time under transaction stats lock

name: HandleDownloadActiveProgress
trigger: request ACTIVE progress before produce

name: HandleDownloadProduce
trigger: ordinary produce returns DATA then EOF; transport contents abstracted

name: HandleDownloadProduceException
trigger: ordinary produce exception prepares FAILED progress and PROCESS_EXCEPTION

name: RefObjServed
trigger: record a provisional serve or return no nonce when already final

name: HandleDownloadTerminalProgress
trigger: choose progress from returned serve nonce and producer RC, outside progress lock

name: HandleDownloadDataProgress
trigger: count one abstract data unit and prepare ACTIVE progress

name: HandleDownloadEndOp
trigger: finally leaves the operation gate before the reply becomes receivable

name: ConsumerReceiveData
trigger: receive DATA and remember cancel capability; one unit consumed next

name: ConsumerLaunchPipeline
trigger: submit next request BEFORE calling consume on the current data

name: ConsumerConsumeReturn
trigger: value-stable consume returns; wait for the already submitted request

name: ConsumerConsumeException
trigger: consume raises; cancel an unstarted future, but an admitted request keeps running

name: ConsumerReceiveEOF
trigger: receive EOF and enter download_completed before sending any confirmation

name: ConsumerDownloadCompleted
trigger: download_completed returns successfully

name: ConsumerDownloadCompletedException
trigger: download_completed raises and schedules FAILED confirmation

name: ConsumerSendConfirm
trigger: send receiver truth only if terminal reply requested nonce-bound confirmation

name: ConsumerReceiveError
trigger: ordinary failed request causes cancellation after acquisition

name: LoseConfirmation
trigger: best-effort confirmation fails to arrive; receiver budgets remain the backstop

name: HandleConfirmBegin
trigger: admit confirmation, preserving nonce requirement for the later final-status lock

name: HandleConfirmLate
trigger: drop confirmation after retirement/closed gate

name: HandleCancelBegin
trigger: admit cancellation before testing transaction-level acquisition

name: HandleCancelLate
trigger: drop cancellation after retirement/closed gate

name: HandleCancelAcquired
trigger: snapshot acquired membership, then iterate all fixed sibling refs

name: FinalizerSelectRef
trigger: select the next ref before acquiring its progress lock

name: RefFinalizeReceiverCommit
trigger: atomic dedup, pending guard, pop, status record and downloaded_to_all latch

name: RefDownloadedToOneReturned
trigger: after guarded downloaded_to_one, independently invoke downloaded_to_all if latched

name: RefDownloadedToAllReturned
trigger: guarded downloaded_to_all returns to the caller

name: RefFinalizerProgress
trigger: after callback return select receiver truth for progress (separate from final commit)

name: FinalizerAdvance
trigger: after receiver publication return to the sibling/candidate loop

name: HandleConfirmMarkActive
trigger: accepted confirmation refreshes transaction clock only, after its callbacks

name: HandleCancelLoopDone
trigger: all sibling cancellation attempts returned

name: FinalizerEndOp
trigger: end operation BEFORE requesting finish-if-complete

name: MonitorBegin
trigger: capture monitor time before budget operations; no absolute transaction-age deadline

name: MonitorAdmitBudgets
trigger: register budget pass as an operation if the transaction is still live

name: EnforceReceiverBudgetsSnapshot
trigger: capture receiver activity once per transaction budget pass under stats lock

name: RefEnforceBudgetSelect
trigger: select a candidate from declared identities; test acquisition/idle using captured receiver clock

name: RefEnforceBudgetRecheck
trigger: freshness recheck under stats lock; release it BEFORE final-status commit

name: MonitorBudgetEndOp
trigger: finish all budget callbacks and leave gate before classification

name: MonitorNoRetirement
trigger: classification leaves a live nonexpired transaction, or notices another terminator won

name: FinishTransactionIfComplete
trigger: table-locked single-winner retirement; monotone final-status scan linearizes at successful check

name: FinishTransactionNotComplete
trigger: helper observes missing transaction or a ref that is not complete

name: MonitorRetireFinished
trigger: monitor retires a finished transaction and schedules its own inline settlement

name: MonitorRetireTimeout
trigger: only after not-finished test, retire on sliding inactivity using monitor sampled time

name: DeleteTransaction
trigger: explicit deletion atomically wins table ownership, then runs settlement outside the lock

name: Shutdown
trigger: atomically clear ownership and receipts; resolve pending waiters with None BEFORE cleanup

name: RefMakeProgressEvent
trigger: construct or suppress a progress event atomically, latching first terminal state

name: TransactionEmitProgressEvent
trigger: invoke public source progress callback after releasing progress lock

name: TransactionProgressCallbackReturn
trigger: progress callback returns or its ordinary Exception is contained; no unmodeled callback mutation

name: CheckedExecutorEnqueue
trigger: enqueue settlement before submission acknowledgement (brief S3; saved stdlib evidence)

name: CheckedExecutorSubmitReturn
trigger: return the Future; the worker may already have started

name: CheckedExecutorSubmitRuntimeError
trigger: post-enqueue non-shutdown RuntimeError propagates; DownloadService selects fallback without dequeuing

name: CheckedExecutorSubmitStopped
trigger: executor declines submission before enqueue and returns None

name: SubmitFinishedSettlementFallback
trigger: run inline fallback; no settlement-entry dedup latch exists

name: SettleFinishedTransactionWorker
trigger: a runnable worker dequeues the existing settlement item, even if submission reported error

name: TransactionDoneDrainBegin
trigger: each settlement invocation independently closes gate and establishes its own drain deadline

name: TransactionDoneDrainEmpty
trigger: drain returns normally once all admitted operations ended

name: TransactionDoneDrainExpired
trigger: after the bounded wait, proceed even with outstanding operations

name: TransactionDoneSnapshotRef
trigger: copy one complete per-ref status map under that ref lock; refs are snapshotted separately

name: TransactionDoneComputeOutcome
trigger: compute strict success and common-receiver quorum from the frozen matrix

name: TransactionDoneComputeException
trigger: contained computation Exception creates an empty fail-closed verdict and still executes cleanup

name: TransactionDoneTerminalProgress
trigger: under one ref lock, set ref-wide terminal override and construct all started-receiver events

name: TransactionDoneProgressReturned
trigger: finish terminal progress callbacks before capturing the base objects

name: TransactionDoneSnapshotBaseObject
trigger: snapshot each infrastructure source reference before object callbacks; another settlement may already release it

name: TransactionDoneObjectsBegin
trigger: begin per-object transaction_done callback loop

name: TransactionDoneObjectCallback
trigger: prepare one guarded object transaction_done callback

name: TransactionDoneObjectReturned
trigger: return to loop after this object hook returned or raised

name: TransactionDoneTransactionCallback
trigger: invoke configured transaction_done_cb with this invocation's base-object snapshot

name: TransactionDoneOutcomeCallback
trigger: after transaction callback return, invoke outcome_cb BEFORE source releases

name: TransactionDoneReleaseBegin
trigger: finally begins release loop despite guarded callback Exceptions

name: TransactionDoneRelease
trigger: prepare each independently guarded release attempt

name: TransactionDoneReleaseReturned
trigger: continue release loop after this source release returned or raised

name: InvokeCallbackSafely
trigger: enter user hook; observer counts invocations/attempts, independently of return or exception

name: ReleaseSourceReference
trigger: owned-source release drops only the infrastructure reference, before its hook returns

name: CallbackReturn
trigger: finite callback returns; no caller phase advances until this return

name: CallbackException
trigger: ordinary callback/release Exception is contained; already visible effects are not undone

name: TransactionDoneRecordReady
trigger: all this invocation's release attempts have returned before on_outcome recording

name: RecordOutcome
trigger: owner-guarded single receipt write; resolve pending waiters atomically with recording

name: RecordOutcomeDrop
trigger: ownership consumed by another record or cleared by shutdown: discard duplicate receipt

name: TransactionDoneComplete
trigger: set settlement_complete after recording returns; this is not an entry latch

name: SyncTerminationMarkerRead
trigger: snapshot whether admitted operations remain under operation lock

name: SyncTerminationMarkerWrite
trigger: sustain or clear marker under table lock using sampled operation state

name: ReapTerminationMarker
trigger: monitor removes a quiescent marker; remaining settlement duplication is not counted by this latch

name: ExpireOutcome
trigger: remove retained receipt after strict greater-than TTL; previously resolved waiters retain their value

name: GetTransferWaiter
trigger: attach a second observer; unswept expired receipt still resolves it, exactly as current API

name: WaitForResultTransfers
trigger: minimal caller barrier: only a non-None strict COMPLETED receipt permits success

name: AdvanceTime
trigger: advance abstract monotone wall time; monitor execution remains independent

name: HandleDownloadProduceError
trigger: produce returns ERROR as an ordinary functional outcome, provisionally awaiting receiver truth

name: ConsumerReceiveProducerError
trigger: terminal ERROR carries nonce; prepare FAILED confirmation without download_completed

name: DownloadRequestWorkerStart
trigger: the submitted pipeline future starts before remote admission; cancel can no longer erase the request
